jolt-arrival-v1.pulse_room: abs(dx)-2; positive toward velocity and upward velocity only; same-height ballistic travel + supported stopping distance + reaction travel
jolt-arrival-v1.pulse_effort: positive analytic quadratic root for available room, capped by caller effort; withhold if below minimum or actual post-pulse vertical speed is not upward
jolt-arrival-v1.supported_drive: desired_x=clamp(position_gain*dx, +/-speed*effort); request=desired_x/(speed*effort); inside settling margin with abs(vx)>arrival_speed request -sign(vx)*near_goal_counter_request
jolt-arrival-v1.arrival_observation_rule: first qualifying sample starts the span; nonqualifying or over-gap samples reset it; this is a local estimate only
jolt-arrival-v1.feedback: issued own-root proprioception, support, cooldown, energy and ceiling ray; explicit caller goal and deadline; no evaluator inputs
jolt-arrival-v1.lifecycle: retire canceled/completed/replaced goals; reject duplicate/stale ticks and generation rollback; new lifetime resets state and retires prior lifetime
jolt-arrival-v1.owner_cancellation: caller must separately revoke the host lease

physical_supervisor.emergency: unstable_attitude must be explicitly requested and observed
physical_supervisor.ordinary_action: passed through without target, launch or posture decisions
physical_supervisor.expiry: exclusive original observation lease, original goal deadline and active emergency deadline
physical_supervisor.authority: retire canceled/replaced/completed goals and prior lifetimes; reject rollback
physical_supervisor.host_cancellation: caller must revoke owner; neutral output alone is not cancellation

jolt-recovery-v3.effort_limit: max(.45, caller pace); never raise it to the minimum hop effort
jolt-recovery-v3.initial_launch: fresh supported anticipation or its exact six-tick supported-to-unsupported transition; current floor<=16, displacement<=.40 and speed<=6; synchronous fresh observation; all pulse bounds rechecked
jolt-recovery-v3.second_launch: same new physical recovery window, cooldown acknowledgment, energy and two-edge limit; shorter local room-bound recovery arc
jolt-recovery-v3.supported_watchdog: 18 fresh ticks of supported directed demand, <=.40 cells toward progress and <=6 cells/s current speed
jolt-recovery-v3.unsupported_edge: 18 fresh unsupported near-ground ticks, <=.40 cells displacement and <=6 cells/s current speed
jolt-recovery-v3.unexpected_descent: observed supported-to-unsupported transition outside the launch interval; 12 fresh unsupported ticks, descent >=12 and below goal
jolt-recovery-v3.pulse_aim: first pulse uses the preserved room/60 projection; recovery pulses normalize their separately solved horizontal/vertical impulse components
jolt-recovery-v3.descent_aim: reduce horizontal aim if needed to leave at least20 cells/s upward velocity within caller effort
jolt-recovery-v3.pulse_room: first pulse uses the preserved positive impulse quadratic; recovery solves the total horizontal velocity quadratic for its fixed bounded lift, then subtracts signed observed toward velocity
jolt-recovery-v3.pulse_bounds: upward result >=20 cells/s, ceiling apex plus6 cells, and remaining time minus.20 seconds settling reserve
jolt-recovery-v3.anticipation: zero traction for six ticks; fresh condition and current room rechecked at launch
jolt-recovery-v3.ordinary_drive: supported desired_x=clamp(2.5*dx,+/-48*effort); ground velocity servo; no free-air traction claim
jolt-recovery-v3.ordinary_posture: lean=.16*desired_x/48; anticipation counterlean=.10; bounded .55 proportional/.20 damping trim with shared shaping
jolt-recovery-v3.arrival: raw supported samples within tolerance, speed<=6 and angle<=.32 over12 observed ticks with gaps<=6 produce an advisory only
jolt-recovery-v3.feedback: only FeedbackObservation whitelist and explicit caller goal; no task evaluator or native mutation
jolt-recovery-v3.evidence: local reasons and requested pulses are not actual impulses, airborne or recovered verdicts
jolt-recovery-v3.arrival_advisory: running neutral hold, unchanged original-source lease and goal deadline; fresh disturbance resumes ordinary correction
jolt-recovery-v3.completion: caller validates outcome and current ownership, then cancels local/native intent; sampled arrival never retires the goal
jolt-recovery-v3.continuous_arrival: unmeasured by sparse policy samples; the unchanged task evaluates every retained physical tick
jolt-recovery-v3.pending_launch: one six-tick anticipation witness; unknown support, gap, motion, admission failure or lost authority discards it; a contact transition keeps only its original start
jolt-recovery-v3.first_pulse_aim: preserved initial room/60 projection for the first pulse regardless of its fresh physical reason
jolt-recovery-v3.recovery_vertical_impulse: max(86*.40, sqrt(2*156*min(7,.25*room)) + current_vy); capped by caller effort, ceiling and original remaining time; post-pulse upward speed>=20
jolt-recovery-v3.recovery_horizontal_impulse: solve total positive horizontal speed from V*(conservative_flight+.1)+V^2/(2*100)<=room; subtract signed existing toward speed; cap vector by caller effort and horizontal aim .82; require positive resulting toward speed
jolt-recovery-v3.recovery_flight: 2*(existing positive upward speed + vertical impulse)/156 plus sqrt(2*max(0,dy)/156); conservative local bound, not a contact simulation
jolt-recovery-v3.recovery_effort: normalize the solved impulse vector; .40 minimum and max(.45,caller pace) maximum; no raised caller budget
jolt-recovery-v3.ordinary_arrival_hold: on current raw support inside caller tolerance, speed<=6 and angle<=.32, request neutral immediately with status running; twelve sampled quiet ticks remain advisory only
jolt-recovery-v3.ordinary_arrival_braking: inside caller tolerance with abs(vx)>6, shaped -sign(vx)*.10 traction; no free-air brake and no success claim
jolt-recovery-v3.ordinary_ground_correction: after both primary edges, a fresh supported no-progress window can request bounded full traction for at most12 ticks; support loss, new motion, gap, quiet envelope or authority change ends it; a new window is required to restart
